children.value: > Fact From Story: Next steps were highly uncertain as lawmakers start offering new ideas for a possible speaker.

> Fact From Story: Republicans dropped Rep. Jim Jordan on Friday as their nominee for House speaker, making the decision during a closed-door session after the hard-edged ally of Donald Trump failed badly on a third ballot for the gavel.
> > Fact From Story: Afterward, Jordan said simply of his colleagues, “We put the question to them, they made a different decision.”
> > > Fact From Story: Friday’s vote was 194 for Jordan, his lowest tally yet, and 210 for Jeffries, with two absences on each side.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A lower vote total indicates less support.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: When a group rejects a leader, they may have made the decision in private.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When a candidate is dropped, the people who supported them need to find a new candidate.
